description: 7Kolor Insights — 独立开发者情报周报索引 / index of weekly intelligence reports

reports.title_zh: 上限与筛子：卡住你的不是能力不够
reports.title_en: Ceilings and Filters: What's Stopping You Isn't Ability
reports.desc_zh: AI 订阅要设上限、接单要设上限、报价要认买方留出的区间；而纸面规则要到流程末端才生效——本周商业情报。
reports.desc_en: Cap your AI subscriptions, cap the work you take on, and price to the band your buyer left open — and the paper rules that filter you only bite at the very end. This week's business intelligence.

reports.title_zh: 给 AI 打零工的人，和给 AI 造工具的人
reports.title_en: Those Who Gig for AI, and Those Who Build for AI
reports.desc_zh: AI 正在把工作拆成两层生意：一端是给 AI 打零工的人，另一端是给 AI 造工具的人；夹在中间的真人溢价在涨价——一位 CEO 开价 13 万美元雇人扮演自己。
reports.desc_en: AI is splitting work into two businesses: gig workers who train AI, and builders who make AI tools — while the premium on real human presence keeps rising.

reports.title_zh: 你看不上的生意，正在赚钱
reports.title_en: The Businesses You Look Down On Are Making Money
reports.desc_zh: 拍照评腹肌的 App 月入五位数，被断言一句话就能抄死的 AI 套壳晒出亿级年收入，被裁的人比在岗贵——本周商业情报，另附七个我们亲手否掉的方向。
reports.desc_en: An abs-rating app clears five figures a month, "copyable" AI wrappers flaunt nine-figure revenue, and laid-off experts cost more than employed ones — this week's business intel, plus seven directions we killed after reading the comments.

reports.title_zh: 议价权的账单，和那个“没人要工具”的空白
reports.title_en: The Bill for Bargaining Power, and the Gap Where Nobody Wants a Tool
reports.desc_zh: 我们读完评论区后，把本周三个候选方向全部否掉了。为什么“没人想要工具”比“没人做过”更值得说。
reports.desc_en: After reading the comment sections, we killed all three of this week's candidate directions. Why "nobody wants a tool" matters more than "nobody has built it".

reports.title_zh: 三场信任崩塌，钱在观望：帮决定、帮搬走、帮验证
reports.title_en: Three Trust Collapses, Money on Hold: Help Decide, Migrate, Verify
reports.desc_zh: 雇主、订阅商、卖家三场信任崩塌同周发生——主推互信报价单；新增上期判断回执栏。
reports.desc_en: trust collapses by employers, subscriptions and sellers in one week. Top pick: the mutual-trust quote sheet; new: last-issue verdict receipts.

reports.title_zh: 买家还在观望，动手的人先醒了：帮人敢下单的三个方向
reports.title_en: Buyers Watch, Builders Move: Three Plays That Help People Commit
reports.desc_zh: 晒单密度 +15% 是唯一超阈值异动，掏钱更谨慎——主推报价基准数据站，第 0 步只要 2 小时。
reports.desc_en: show-off density +15% is the only above-noise move; buyers hesitate. Top pick: a repair-price benchmark site — step zero takes 2 hours.

reports.title_zh: 需求还在，买家在观望：八大方向的需求×供给对照
reports.title_en: Demand Persists, Buyers Hesitate: A Demand x Supply Map in Eight Directions
reports.desc_zh: ① 家庭维修自诊是全年最大真空，供给全是玩具规模；② 记账类工具几乎全哑火，单环节幸存者活得很好；③ AI agent 供给爆炸遇上买方疲劳——PH 票数是同行鼓掌，Reddit 评论区才是用户表情。
reports.desc_en: 1) home-repair self-diagnosis is the year's biggest vacuum; 2) bookkeeping tools flopped while single-workflow survivors thrive; 3) AI-agent supply explosion meets buyer fatigue - PH votes are peer applause, Reddit comments are the user's face.

reports.title_zh: 非工程师的真实抱怨，是更大的金矿
reports.title_en: Non-Engineers' Raw Complaints Are the Bigger Gold Mine
reports.desc_zh: ① 会计/护士/小房东等非工程师的重复流程痛是最大机会面；② 系统运维(7:1)、创业者(6:1)开发者工具几乎没人做；③ 职场高赞是「反辞职自保」实用主义。
reports.desc_en: ① non-engineers' repetitive-workflow pain (AP/handover/rent-chase) is the biggest surface; ② dev tools in sysadmin (7:1) and entrepreneurs (6:1) gaps are barely built; ③ career top-upvotes are 'anti-quit, self-protect' pragmatism.

reports.title_zh: AI 替代焦虑遇上裁员潮反转：双信号之下的职业保障窗口
reports.title_en: AI Job-Replacement Anxiety Meets the Layoff Reversal: The Career-Security Window
reports.desc_zh: ① 55% 高管后悔 AI 裁员、Visa 反向裁掉 $500K 高管——AI 裁员潮出现对冲；② $70/小时真人 AI 质检服务，付费需求成型；③ 超大规模厂商预订 2027 全球 50% RAM 供应，自托管/AI 硬件成本上行。
reports.desc_en: ① 55% of execs regret AI-driven layoffs and Visa cuts its own $500K hires—the layoff wave is reversing; ② $70/hr human AI quality-checking: a new paid service category forming; ③ hyperscalers book 50% of 2027 global RAM supply—self-hosted & AI hardware costs rising.

reports.title_zh: AI Agent 基础设施产品化与 AI 治理新赛道
reports.title_en: AI Agent Infrastructure Productization & AI Governance as New Track
reports.desc_zh: 大模型周：GPT-6-Astra / Fable 5.1 / Gemini 3.8 Flash 同周发布，AI 创作交付层、AI 治理质检与端侧自托管成为被数据验证的三条机会赛道。
reports.desc_en: Mega-release week: GPT-6-Astra / Fable 5.1 / Gemini 3.8 Flash all landed. AI creation delivery, AI governance/QC, and edge self-hosting are three data-validated tracks.

reports.title_zh: AI 编程可信度危机与定价获客
reports.title_en: AI Coding Reliability Crisis & Pricing as Growth
reports.desc_zh: AI 编程从「万能」到「不可靠」的共识正在形成；取消免费试用+翻倍定价 23 天做到 $1,600 MRR；合规成本上升为隐性威胁。
reports.desc_en: Consensus forms that AI coding is 'unreliable'; removing free trial + doubling price hit $1,600 MRR in 23 days; compliance costs rise as hidden threat.
